correctness.rationale: The bracket on L=U⊕W⊕(U⊗W) is central, alternating even in char2. A mixed horizontal x=(u,w), u,w!=0, commutes with y=(u′,w′) iff u⊗w′=u′⊗w; applying a linear functional taking u↦1 yields y proportional to x. Consequently abelian horizontal spaces T are precisely any U-subspace, any nonzero W-subspace, or a mixed line, counting zero only once. Every full abelian H corresponds bijectively to image T, central intersection C and graph of f:T→Z/C. Over Fq, exactly Gaussian(h,j)·q^{t(h-j)} lifts for each T of dimension t and central j, yielding the stated complete generating polynomial. Maximal ones contain Z, with horizontal types U,W or a mixed line, giving number 2+(q^a−1)(q^b−1)/(q−1). Independent complete F2^5 RREF subspace enumeration for (a,b,q)=(1,2,2) gives dimension counts [1,31,59,19,1,0] as predicted; the symbolic reasoning proves all a,b,characteristics.
residual_risks: Only a small finite field and small a,b independently enumerated; all-case proof is the tensor centralizer and central-lift classification.
